name: Pediatric mature B-cell lymphoma (Burkitt-type): LMB-Modified Group B (FAB/LMB96 / COG ANHL1131) COPADM induction + Rituximab with intrathecal CNS prophylaxis
disease: Pediatric aggressive mature B-cell lymphoma (Burkitt lymphoma / diffuse large B-cell lymphoma)
histology: mature (surface-immunoglobulin-positive) aggressive B-cell lymphoma: Burkitt lymphoma or diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; TdT/CD34 negative to exclude lymphoblastic lymphoma
stage: IV (CNS-negative, bone marrow <25% lymphoma cells) (Group B)

biomarkers.MYC_rearrangement: tested by FISH (MYC break-apart or MYC::IGH probe); the recommended test for MYC rearrangement in Burkitt lymphoma
biomarkers.note: Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas v1.2026. MYC rearrangement is detected by FISH using a MYC break-apart or MYC::IGH probe (ped_b-cell.txt lines 147, 201 to 202, 303). TdT and/or CD34 by IHC/flow help exclude lymphoblastic lymphoma (line 142). MYC grounds tumor identity; it does not gate a specific per-drug dose here (the cytotoxic FAB/LMB backbone is not biomarker-restricted).

treatmentSetting: multiphase curative-intent immunochemotherapy: optional COP pre-phase, then risk-group-adapted induction (2 cycles COPADM) and CYVE consolidation, with intrathecal CNS-directed therapy

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: FAB/LMB risk-group GROUP B only (CNS-negative: stage III with high LDH, or CNS-negative stage IV with bone marrow <25% lymphoma cells). Group C (any CNS involvement) is OUT OF SCOPE for this Group-B protocol: Group C requires high-dose methotrexate escalation to 8 g/m2 during COPADM-2 plus additional intrathecal therapy (ped_b-cell.txt line 1347), so a CNS-positive child must use a separate Group-C protocol (VERIFY) rather than this 3 g/m2 Group-B regimen
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas v1.2026
eligibilityCriteria.locator: ped_b-cell.txt lines 462 to 471 (Group Classification; Group B CNS-negative vs Group C = any CNS involvement), 500 to 576 (FAB/LMB96 / COG ANHL1131 regimen A/B pathways), line 1347 (Group C HD-MTX 8 g/m2 during COPADM 2)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: LMB-Modified Group B Chemotherapy + Rituximab based on FAB/LMB96 (COG ANHL1131), delivered as response-adapted courses starting with COPADM and continuing to CYVE
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas v1.2026
eligibilityCriteria.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1550 (LMB-Modified B/C + Rituximab based on FAB/LMB96; this protocol scopes the Group B arm), lines 555 to 576 (COG ANHL1131 regimen B starting with COPADM 1 + rituximab; CYVE 1 + rituximab)

drugs.name: Rituximab

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1563 (COPADM: Rituximab 375 mg/m2/day on Day 1); rituximab dosing 375 mg/m2 line 224

drugs.notes: Anti-CD20 backbone of the COPADM immunochemotherapy course. Printed dose 375 mg/m2 IV Day 1 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1563). Rituximab premedication and infusion-reaction monitoring required.

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide (COPADM fractionated)

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1566 (COPADM: Cyclophosphamide 250 mg/m2 every 12 Hours on Days 2 to 4); COP pre-phase Cyclophosphamide 300 mg/m2 Day 1 line 1556

drugs.notes: COPADM fractionated alkylator: printed 250 mg/m2 every 12 hours on Days 2 to 4 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1566). In the optional COP pre-phase the printed cyclophosphamide dose is 300 mg/m2 on Day 1 (line 1556). Mesna and hydration per institution.

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1564 (COPADM: Vincristine 2 mg/m2/day on Day 1); COP pre-phase Vincristine 2 mg/m2 Day 1 line 1557

drugs.notes: Printed dose 2 mg/m2 IV on Day 1 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1564). ISMP tall-man vinCRIStine; StewardMD 2 mg per-dose cap applied (the FAB/LMB regimen conventionally caps vincristine at 2 mg per dose, consistent with this cap). vinCRIStine is IV only and fatal if given intrathecally.

drugs.name: methotrexate (high-dose)

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1565 (COPADM: Methotrexate 3 g/m2/day on Day 1); leucovorin rescue line 1570

drugs.notes: High-dose methotrexate, printed as 3 g/m2 (recorded here as 3000 mg/m2 to fit the unit enum) IV on Day 1 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1565). This 3 g/m2 is the GROUP B (CNS-negative) dose. SAFETY: Group C / CNS-positive disease requires HD-MTX escalation to 8 g/m2 during COPADM-2 plus additional intrathecal therapy (ped_b-cell.txt line 1347) and is OUT OF SCOPE for this Group-B protocol; a CNS-positive child must use a separate Group-C protocol (VERIFY) and must NOT be run on 3 g/m2 (sub-therapeutic). ISMP tall-man methotrexate. MANDATORY leucovorin rescue (see leucovorin entry) with methotrexate-level monitoring and hydration/alkalinization per protocol.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1567 (COPADM: Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2/day on Day 2), line 1568 (may administer dexrazoxane at a 10:1 dexrazoxane:doxorubicin ratio)

drugs.notes: Printed dose 60 mg/m2 IV on Day 2 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1567). ISMP tall-man DOXOrubicin. Dexrazoxane cardioprotection at a 10:1 ratio may be administered (line 1568). Cumulative-lifetime warn 250 mg/m2 (pediatric doxorubicin-equivalent threshold) is grounded in the ped anthracycline/dexrazoxane guidance; 350 mg/m2 is the conservative pediatric hard ceiling (below the adult 550; dexrazoxane per COG), matching the pediatric guard used in ped-neuroblastoma.

drugs.name: Prednisone

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1569 (COPADM: Prednisone 60 mg/m2/day divided BID on Days 1 to 5); COP pre-phase Prednisone 60 mg/m2 BID Days 1 to 7 line 1558

drugs.notes: Printed dose 60 mg/m2/day divided BID on Days 1 to 5 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1569). In the optional COP pre-phase, prednisone 60 mg/m2/day BID runs Days 1 to 7 (line 1558).

drugs.name: Leucovorin (methotrexate rescue)

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1570 (Leucovorin 15 mg/m2/dose every 6 Hours, starting 24 Hours after start of Methotrexate, until cleared)

drugs.notes: MANDATORY high-dose-methotrexate rescue. Printed dose 15 mg/m2/dose every 6 hours, beginning 24 hours after the start of methotrexate, continued until methotrexate is cleared (ped_b-cell.txt line 1570). Days shown are indicative of the post-methotrexate window; continue per measured methotrexate levels.

drugs.name: Intrathecal methotrexate / hydrocortisone (age-based)

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
provenance.locator: ped_b-cell.txt line 1571 (COPADM: IT Methotrexate/Hydrocortisone age based dosing on Day 2, prior to start of Leucovorin); COP pre-phase IT MTX/Hydrocortisone age-based Day 1 line 1559

drugs.notes: MANDATORY CNS-directed therapy. Dosing is AGE-BASED (footnote reference), and the numeric age bands are not printed in the extract, so basis, dose, and unit are VERIFY. Intrathecal agents are methotrexate and hydrocortisone; vinCRIStine must NEVER be given intrathecally. Additional intrathecal doses are given if a COP pre-phase is used (line 1553).

premedications.name: Rituximab premedication
premedications.notes: per protocol before each rituximab infusion

premedications.name: High-dose methotrexate support
premedications.notes: hyperhydration, urine alkalinization, and methotrexate-level monitoring per protocol before/after the 3 g/m2 methotrexate; leucovorin rescue mandatory

supportiveCare: tumor lysis syndrome (HIGH risk in Burkitt lymphoma): rasburicase 0.1 to 0.2 mg/kg single dose for high tumor burden, contraindicated in G6PD deficiency; hydration; monitor potassium/phosphate/calcium/uric acid (ped_b-cell.txt lines 1844 to 1857)
mandatory leucovorin rescue and methotrexate-level monitoring after the 3 g/m2 high-dose methotrexate (ped_b-cell.txt line 1570)
anthracycline cardioprotection: dexrazoxane at a 10:1 dexrazoxane:doxorubicin ratio may be administered (ped_b-cell.txt line 1568); track cumulative doxorubicin-equivalent dose
the induction phase is 2 cycles of COPADM followed by CYVE consolidation (ped_b-cell.txt line 1561; COG ANHL1131 CYVE lines 555 to 576)
antiemetic and growth-factor support per NCCN tiers

monitoring: CBC with differential before each course and during aplasia
renal/hepatic function and methotrexate levels during and after high-dose methotrexate
tumor lysis labs (LDH, uric acid, potassium, calcium, phosphorus, creatinine) intensively during the first course
cardiac assessment and cumulative doxorubicin-equivalent tracking
response assessment (FDG-PET/CT with Deauville) to drive response-adapted continuation

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1000 or platelets < 100k at course start
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. COG ANHL1131 / FAB-LMB96 count-recovery criteria apply per course; physician decides.

doseModificationRules.condition: delayed methotrexate clearance / rising creatinine after high-dose methotrexate
doseModificationRules.text: Escalate leucovorin per measured methotrexate levels and consider glucarpidase; physician decides.

core.locator: harrison.txt Chapter 111 (childhood ALL/Burkitt maintenance framework, lines 120044 to 120047 note Burkitt leukemia maintenance shortened to 0.5 to 1 year), supporting the short-intensive nature of mature B-NHL therapy; primary regimen grounding is the NCCN pediatric guideline layer

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas
guideline.locator: ped_b-cell.txt: LMB-Modified B/C + Rituximab based on FAB/LMB96 (line 1550), COP pre-phase (lines 1555 to 1560), COPADM printed doses (lines 1561 to 1572), COG ANHL1131 regimen B / CYVE pathways (lines 555 to 576), risk-group classification and CNS definition (lines 462 to 480), MYC rearrangement FISH (lines 147, 201 to 202, 303), TLS supportive care (lines 1844 to 1857)

provenanceNote: PEDIATRIC. StewardMD draft for pediatric aggressive mature B-cell (Burkitt-type) lymphoma. Unusually for a pediatric protocol, the COPADM induction per-drug doses ARE printed in Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Pediatric Aggressive Mature B-Cell Lymphomas v1.2026 for the LMB-Modified Group B + Rituximab regimen (based on FAB/LMB96 / COG ANHL1131), and are used verbatim as sourced with locators: Rituximab 375 mg/m2 Day 1 (ped_b-cell.txt line 1563), Vincristine 2 mg/m2 Day 1 (line 1564), Methotrexate 3 g/m2 Day 1 recorded as 3000 mg/m2 (line 1565), Cyclophosphamide 250 mg/m2 every 12 hours Days 2 to 4 (line 1566), Doxorubicin 60 mg/m2 Day 2 (line 1567), Prednisone 60 mg/m2/day BID Days 1 to 5 (line 1569), Leucovorin 15 mg/m2 every 6 hours from 24 hours after methotrexate until cleared (line 1570). Only the intrathecal methotrexate/hydrocortisone dose is AGE-BASED and not numerically printed, so it remains the literal VERIFY (listed in verifyFields); cycleLengthDays and cycles are VERIFY because the multiphase count-recovery schedule is not fully printed. No pediatric dose was invented. SCOPE: this protocol covers GROUP B (CNS-negative) only, so the modeled methotrexate is the Group B 3 g/m2 (3000 mg/m2) dose. Group C / CNS-positive disease is OUT OF SCOPE because it requires high-dose methotrexate escalation to 8 g/m2 during COPADM-2 plus additional intrathecal therapy (ped_b-cell.txt line 1347); a CNS-positive child must be routed to a separate Group-C protocol (VERIFY) and must not be run on 3 g/m2. The ISMP vinCRIStine 2 mg per-dose cap and DOXOrubicin/methotrexate tall-man conventions are carried; mandatory TLS prophylaxis (high risk in Burkitt) and high-dose-methotrexate leucovorin rescue are included; vinCRIStine is IV only and never intrathecal. NCCN per-disease template alignment, StewardMD clinical (R1) review, and any hospital-implementation overlay approval are pending. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
